scope: Compact R5.3 single-copper LUT CAD, documentation and 1:1 print set. No physical fabrication/measurement.

print_visual_review.limits: Visual review and vector scale only; physical printer scale, material fit and wire dressing unverified.

known_limits: U1 body/protrusions and actual capacitors still need physical 1:1 fit.
All nine insulated W1-W9 required; six bottom surface wires need mechanical fixing.
S1 nearest LP1 copper clearance 25.138 mm; real harness and solder must be checked, wires exit left.
U1 minimum narrow annulus .35mm needs accurate LUT/drilling; C5 pad gap .8mm.
Ground erosion does not account for holes, etch tolerances or HF current.
No calibrated response, protection, allowable input voltage or vehicle approval inferred.
No application, firmware, COM, SWD or physical signal tests in this iteration.
